brands.evidence: Monzo (Clear Winner): Monzo’s app is best-in-class.
Nationwide (Clear Winner): ... Nationwide is the obvious choice.

client_claims.text: Cash deposits must be done at PayPoint stores, costing £1 per deposit, with limits of £300 per transaction and £1,000 every 180 days on standard accounts.
client_claims.note: Deposit terms are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Paid tiers (Extra, Perks, Max) cost £3 to £17/month.
client_claims.note: Max is from £19 a month, so the range tops out at £17, which is wrong. Extra at £3 is correct.

client_claims.text: The standard free account pays 0% interest on your main balance, though you can open instant-access savings pots powered by partner banks.
client_claims.note: F9 gives a 2.80% Instant Access Savings rate but does not cover the main balance interest or partner banks.

client_claims.text: Monzo passes on the Mastercard wholesale exchange rate with 0% foreign transaction fees on debit card spending worldwide.
Fee-free international ATM withdrawal allowance of £200 every 30 days on the free tier.
Monzo's app has instant push notifications, automated budgeting categories, bill-splitting and Pots.
client_claims.note: App features are not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Paid tiers offer credit score tracking, higher cash deposit limits, and packaged travel/phone insurance.
client_claims.note: Plan features are not covered by the facts.
